name: story_list_content
description: List indexed documents in the current Story, ordered newest to oldest. Start with page 1 and continue with pagination.nextPage when present.

name: story_get_content
description: Copy documents selected from story_list_content into the current AI Session workspace.

name: story_set_content
description: Create or replace one indexed Story document from a workspace file; use expectedRevision to prevent overwriting a newer version.

name: story_list_actions
description: List preset Actions in the Story assigned to the current AI Session.

name: story_run_action
description: Run one preset Story Action using its configured target instance and session preset.

name: story_list_automations
description: List Automations and their effective status for the current Story.

name: story_create_automation
description: Create a long-lived Automation using an existing preset Action in the current Story.

name: story_update_automation
description: Update or enable an Automation in the current Story with optimistic concurrency.

name: story_delete_automation
description: Delete an Automation in the current Story with optimistic concurrency.

name: story_run_automation
description: Run an Automation in the current Story immediately.

name: story_list_automation_runs
description: List recent runs for an Automation in the current Story.

name: story_list_ai_sessions
description: List other active root AI Sessions assigned to the current Story.

name: story_get_ai_session
description: Read compact session details and Turn summaries for another active root AI Session in the current Story.

name: story_get_ai_session_turn
description: Read one Turn's conversation and tool items from another active root AI Session in the current Story.

name: story_request_decision
description: Register a Story decision that requires a human ruling. Calling this tool ends the current turn: it returns immediately with a decisionId and the human's response arrives later as a new turn in this same AI Session. Use it when a genuine human judgment is required, not for ordinary questions that can be answered by continuing work.

name: agent_run
description: Run an Agent authorized for this Story and wait for its bounded final result.
